title: Movie Ticket Booking with a Reentrant Lock
instructions: Implement `MovieTicketBookingSystem` and `book_seats` in `config/movieBooking.py`. The system tracks `total_seats` and `available_seats` behind a `threading.RLock` named `lock`. `reserve_seats` checks and decrements inside one critical section, returning `True` or `False`, so many threads can book without ever overbooking.

evidence.label: Starts with all seats free and uses an RLock
Reserves seats and leaves the count unchanged on failure
Allows booking exactly the remaining seats, then refuses
Never overbooks when many threads book at once
Accounts for every seat with larger bookings
Check and decrement form one critical section
reserve_seats and get_available_seats hold the lock
book_seats prints the success or failure message
